notes.title: 2025/6/23 Update
notes.notes: 1. Reduce the time that smoke and debris from meteorite and missile explosions stay on the scene to avoid blocking the screen.

notes.title: 2025/6/20 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that the big gold coin has a chance to fall off the cliff after the boss of the fourth stage dies.
2. Optimize the shadow presentation on the mobile terminal.
3. Optimize the recovery mechanism of monsters in spawn and non-combat.
4. Optimize the movement mode of monsters when the FPS is too low.

notes.title: 2025/6/13 Update
notes.notes:
1.Slow down HP growth of Hell Island monsters.
2.Boost shield skill’s initial attacks and damage growth; lower attack count growth.
3.Increase Skeleton Archer damage growth after level 11; stop raising skeleton count.
4.Increase missile damage growth after level 11; stop reducing cooldown.
5.Increase Chain Lightning damage growth after level 11; stop adding segments.
6.Optimize resource use for arrows, missiles, and Chain Lightning.

notes.title: 2025/6/9 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the interface and monster performance consumption.
2. Add the function of adjusting the mouse sensitivity of the Steam version.
3. Fix the bug that the mobile gold coin product description text is mistakenly typed as the Steam version.
4. Cancel the mobile double-finger zoom lens function and use the lens zoom button instead.
5. Fix the bug that the meteor spell targets the wrong enemy.

notes.title: 2025/6/6 Update
notes.notes: 1. Fixed a bug where monsters would get stuck on cliffs under certain circumstances.

notes.title: 2025/6/4 Update
notes.notes:
1.Fixed rare bug where monsters get stuck on cliff edges.
2.Optimized attack system and background processing performance.
3.Adjusted shuriken rotation range to slightly increase with level.
4.Improved skeleton archer tracking to better protect players.
5.Fixed bug causing slower spawn and monster growth due to device lag.

notes.title: 2025/6/1 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the animation of monster's health reduction.
2. Optimize the knockback triggering interval speed of the shield skill. Now the higher the total number of knockbacks, the faster the knockback triggering speed.

notes.title: 2025/5/30 Temporary Update
notes.notes: 1.Fixed a bug where achievements were not triggered when completing a level with a weapon.

notes.title: 2025/5/30 Update
notes.notes:
1.Fixed monsters sometimes not disappearing on death.
2.Fixed background music crashing with many monsters.
3.Reduced Hell Island difficulty and adjusted spawns.
4.Fixed dagger special attack glitch on Hell Island.
5.Added Google Play and Steam achievements (21 languages).
6.Fixed mobile auto-aim bug when pausing.

notes.title: 2025/5/26 Temporary Update
notes.notes: 1. Fixed the bug that the camera could not be rotated by moving the mouse after closing the pause menu in the battle stage.

notes.title: 2025/5/26 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the material of dropped gold coins to improve the problem of unclear gold coins in the fourth level.
2. Optimize the texture of the fourth level terrain and improve the problem of the fourth level floor not being clear.
3. Fixed the issue where missile smoke display was abnormal due to game file compression.
4. Fixed the problem of abnormal display of meteorites and campfire smoke caused by game file compression.
